summary: Iter 4 testing: Backend 21/21 pytest passed (added visual_areas_v1v5.nii.gz + destrieux.nii.gz + destrieux_labels.json with verified 151 entries). Frontend: Destrieux atlas loads & renders correctly in Atlases section. Visual Areas V1-V5 (real cytoarchitectonic from Juelich 48-52) loads. Polar Angle disc visually updates to turbo gradient when colormap changed (verified in screenshot top-right render pane). ClusterPanel appears after activation upload — threshold slider, minsize slider, sign buttons (pos/neg/abs), activation-colorbar-toggle, cluster-run, cluster-export are all present and clickable. OverlapPanel appears after lesion upload with overlap-lesion-select / overlap-atlas-select populated with visible standard atlases (Destrieux shown). Drawing-toggle activates. Found ONE coding bug (tractDirectionMap was undefined) — fixed inline so tract uploads now work. Two functional issues need main-agent attention: (a) cluster-run with a valid activation map (peaks 3.5 and 4.2, threshold 2.3) produced 0 clusters — cluster-table did not populate; CSV download timed out. (b) overlap-run between lesion and Destrieux atlas returned 0 rows due to voxel-space mismatch (lesion 11.4M voxels vs Destrieux 537k voxels — they live in different grids).

integration_issues.issue: cluster-run with valid activation map (peaks 3.5 & 4.2 vs threshold 2.3) returned 0 clusters; cluster-table never populates; cluster-export download event never fires. findClusters() in volumeAnalysis.js may have an issue iterating vol.img or matching layer id when niivue normalizes the typed array to a different range. Activation overlay renders visually (warm orange blobs in occipital). Suggest E1: add console.log of {imgLen, nonZeroCount, maxValue} at the top of findClusters to confirm input then verify BFS reaches voxels. Also consider that vol.img may be normalized to 0..255 after niivue load — if so, threshold needs scaling via cal_min/cal_max.

overlap-run with lesion(/tmp/test_lesion.nii.gz, MNI152 0.74mm grid, 11,393,280 voxels) vs Destrieux atlas (537,168 voxels) returns 0 rows. computeAtlasOverlap requires matching voxel grids; console warns 'Lesion/atlas not in same space'. UX: either resample on-the-fly or surface this constraint in the panel before running. Works conceptually when atlases share the lesion grid.

action_items: Investigate ClusterPanel.runAnalysis → findClusters() returning 0 clusters even when activation map clearly has supra-threshold voxels. Likely candidates: (1) BFS algorithm in volumeAnalysis.js iterating wrong, (2) vol.img after niivue load may be normalized to 0..255 uint8 so threshold 2.3 corresponds to a different physical value — should use vol.cal_min/cal_max scaling or vol.hdr.scl_slope. Adding a debug toast 'scanned N voxels, M above threshold' would self-diagnose this.

OverlapPanel: when lesion and atlas voxel grids differ, computeAtlasOverlap returns empty. Options: (a) resample atlas to lesion grid using nearest-neighbour, (b) show a banner 'Atlas/lesion grid mismatch — overlap may be inaccurate', (c) silently warp via niivue's affine matrices. AAL/HO_cort match MNI152 grid (~10M voxels) so they'll work; Destrieux/Juelich are at native 2mm so they need resampling.

PolarAngleDisc inner container should expose data-testid="polar-disc" for automated colormap-change verification (currently the visual gradient updates correctly but the test cannot locate the disc element).
Re-gzip /app/frontend/public/atlases/aal_atlas.nii.gz (was already noted iter-3; still uncompressed despite .nii.gz extension).
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx had `tractDirectionMap.current[id] = colorByDirection` at line 260 but `tractDirectionMap` was never declared as a useRef — would throw ReferenceError on any tract upload. Fixed inline by adding `const tractDirectionMap = useRef({});` next to the other refs.

ClusterPanel selects activation layer by `nv.volumes.find((v) => v?.name === id)`. Since niivue rewrites vol.name to URL basename on add, the manual `vol.name = layerCfg.id` patch from iter-3 must be applied to user-uploaded volumes too (addOverlayFromFile path) — needs verification by E1 that user activation uploads also get name overridden.
Dashboard.jsx is now ~580 lines — continued growth. Extract UserLayerSection wrapping FileUploader + UserLayerList per-type as recommended in iter-3.

OverlapPanel does not validate that the lesion and atlas share voxel grids before iterating — silently produces empty result. Should compute min(lesionImg.length, atlasImg.length) and short-circuit with a clear toast 'grids differ, resample required'.

success_rate.frontend: ~80% of new iter-4 surface verified (cluster execution & overlap-with-mismatched-grids are the two functional misses)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 4: Backend assets all verified (visual_areas_v1v5, destrieux + 151-label JSON). Frontend Destrieux + V1-V5 atlases load OK. ClusterPanel + OverlapPanel components mount correctly and all controls are wired (verified by data-testid presence + screenshot). Two functional issues remain (see action_items): cluster-run finds 0 clusters on a clearly supra-threshold map — strongly suspect normalisation in niivue's vol.img (uint8 normalisation) breaks the raw threshold compare; and OverlapPanel cannot match grids when atlas resolution ≠ lesion resolution. Tract-direction toggle test was skipped (no .trk fixture in /tmp), but the `tractDirectionMap` undefined bug was fixed so tract upload should now succeed. For cluster retest, AAL atlas grid matches MNI152, so use AAL (not Destrieux) for overlap until resampling lands. /tmp/test_activation.nii.gz and /tmp/test_lesion.nii.gz are still on disk for re-runs.
rca_of_the_issue: (1) tractDirectionMap missing useRef — Dashboard.jsx had handleTractUpload referencing tractDirectionMap.current but never declared the ref → would throw on first tract upload. RCA: variable name introduced for state plumbing without the corresponding useRef declaration. Fix: added `const tractDirectionMap = useRef({});` next to userFileCache ref. (2) cluster-run zero result: highest probability is that niivue's addVolumeFromFile path normalises typed array values into a different scale (e.g. mapping data range → 0..255 uint8 for GPU upload) — meaning the 2.3 threshold check inside findClusters compares against post-normalised values. Need to either read raw data via vol.hdr/img2 buffer or scale threshold by (cal_max/255) before the BFS. (3) overlap zero result: dimension mismatch — lesion was at 207×256×215 (11.4M vox) but destrieux is at lower resolution 91×109×91 or similar (537k vox). BFS over different-length arrays produces no matches because index space is incompatible. Need affine-aware resampling.
